entries.summary: Local Storage members support additional environment variables through Helm `localStorage.member.extraEnv` or the Cluster annotation `hwameistor.io/local-storage-member-extra-env`.
entries.impact: Additions, changes and removals update existing DaemonSets; invalid annotation JSON stops reconciliation.
upgradeNotes: If you manually customized the member container's environment, move those customizations to `localStorage.member.extraEnv` or the Cluster annotation before upgrading; reconciliation now replaces the complete environment list.

entries.summary: Local Storage now defaults to `--migrate-check=true` and reconciles this setting on existing DaemonSets.
entries.impact: Helm `localStorage.migrate.check` controls the Operator's `MIGRATE_CHECK` environment variable; invalid environment values stop reconciliation.
upgradeNotes: To retain disabled migration checks, set Helm `localStorage.migrate.check=false`, or set `MIGRATE_CHECK=false` on the Operator Deployment for non-Helm installations.

entries.summary: Migration configuration defaults to image tag `v1.2.0` and member `JUICEFS_VERSION=1.2.0`, configurable through Helm `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version`.
entries.impact: Operator image defaulting fills only empty fields; per-Cluster version overrides in `localStorage.member.extraEnv` retain declaration order and `valueFrom` references.
upgradeNotes: If your Helm values retain an older migration image tag and you want the new image default, explicitly set `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.tag=v1.2.0`; existing nonempty Cluster image settings are not automatically replaced by Operator defaulting.

excluded.reason: Changes PR-check branch coverage and the checkout action only, without changing installed product behavior.
Aligns internal PR and release workflow branch filters; it introduces no chart, image or runtime behavior changes.
Adds maintainer release-preparation automation, validation and supporting documentation; installed product behavior and publication handling remain unchanged.
